gates.gate: no single service unmatched p95 above 10% @10% armed

causal_finding.statement: the work-avoidance property holds perfectly and is NOT the problem; the cost is the process-wide async_hooks tax, which is paid permanently once capture has been activated even when zero capture work is performed
causal_finding.decisive_evidence: ARMED_UNMATCHED_ONLY: 150 captures forced during activation, then 0 requests selected and 0 boundary events recorded during the entire measured interval, alsEnabled=true throughout, median throughput 1488.1 rps against OFF_MIXED 1578.4 rps (-5.7%) and unmatched p95 +5.07%
causal_finding.mechanism: AsyncLocalStorage is enabled lazily by the first selected request and can never quiesce again while a route remains armed, because hasActivePreArm() reports the pre-armed rule set as live arming
causal_finding.flat_floor: the degradation is approximately flat in armed rate (-5.86% at 0% armed, -5.54% at 1%, -7.74% at 10%, -9.59% at 25%), so most of it is the activation tax rather than the cost of the selected requests themselves
causal_finding.relation_to_v3_1: V3.1 measured this configuration at -1.14% throughput, but in a process that had NEVER activated capture. That result is not comparable and its host was additionally contended; V3.2 supersedes it.
